## History

Lauretta was a fat, placid child who maintained an irreproachable record of conduct in church from infancy. She later attended a pleasant tea at the manse alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Her streak of peaceful church attendance was disrupted when [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) dropped a caterpillar down her dress during a service.
